messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

Radar-related technology is moving toward higher bandwidth, communications-plus-sensing integration, spectrum coexistence, waveform-design challenges, and joint communications/radar sensing concepts [60][62].  
Automotive radar echo generation in the knowledge base already covers 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar bands, instantaneous bandwidth up to 5 GHz, artificial object distance up to 3000 m, and Doppler/velocity simulation capability [4].  
For radar echo testing, AREG800A is specified as an automotive radar echo generator using dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid analog/digital or fully digital echo generation concepts [2].  
Its artificial-object capability includes distance ranges up to 3000 m and per-object Doppler frequency shift, so radar testers must emulate range and velocity, not only generate static RF signals [4].  
For signaling testers, the raw evidence states that integrating the CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS lets mobile-device manufacturers use “advanced multi-technology and multi-channel signaling testing capabilities” [65].  
The implication for signaling testers is that when radar evolves toward communication-integrated sensing, the signaling tester must support multi-technology and multi-channel signaling rather than a single narrow radio link [65].  
The CMX500 knowledge base supports this direction because it is a one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, BLER, throughput, WLAN, and application testing [16][17].  
For non-signaling testers, the raw evidence explicitly identifies “non-signaling” and “with signaling” as separate modes or contexts [66].  
The implication for non-signaling testers is that radar-related measurement needs remain RF-parametric and waveform-centric when no live protocol connection is required [66].  
The CMP200 knowledge base supports this role because it forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution with remote radio heads for RF parametric testing in R&D and manufacturing [43][45].  
The CMP200 also supports mixed radiated mmWave, conducted IF, and conducted mmWave setups for fully assembled devices and mmWave RF integrated circuits, which is relevant when radar or sensing functions move into mmWave hardware [45].  
The CMX500 non-signaling/GPRF material supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF generator instances, and ARB sequencing for standalone waveform generation [55].  
The CMX500 IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save `.wv` files for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling, which supports reuse between signaling and non-signaling workflows [57].  
【推論】As radar shifts from narrow standalone sensing toward high-bandwidth and communications-integrated sensing, signaling testers need broader multi-technology/multi-channel protocol capability, while non-signaling testers need wider-band RF generation/analysis, waveform replay, spectrum analysis, and mmWave/IF measurement paths [60][62][65][45][55].  
【推論】Automotive radar echo testing also requires radar-specific emulation such as artificial range, Doppler, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz bandwidth coverage, which ordinary communication signaling alone does not cover [2][4][11].

這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

- Base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth 依 option 為 `1 GHz`、`2 GHz` 或 `5 GHz`；overrange 分別為 `1.2 GHz (meas.)`、`2.2 GHz (meas.)`、`5.2 GHz (meas.)`。
- AREG800A base unit IF frequency range：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`；來源另列 [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`，但 5 GHz bandwidth ordering information 顯示還涉及 [[R&S AREG8-K528]]，此處未自行推論修正。

Radar-related technology is moving toward higher bandwidth, communications-plus-sensing integration, spectrum coexistence, waveform-design challenges, and joint communications/radar sensing concepts [60][62].  
Automotive radar echo generation in the knowledge base already covers 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar bands, instantaneous bandwidth up to 5 GHz, artificial object distance up to 3000 m, and Doppler/velocity simulation capability [4].  
For radar echo testing, AREG800A is specified as an automotive radar echo generator using dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid analog/digital or fully digital echo generation concepts [2].  
Its artificial-object capability includes distance ranges up to 3000 m and per-object Doppler frequency shift, so radar testers must emulate range and velocity, not only generate static RF signals [4].  
For signaling testers, the raw evidence states that integrating the CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS lets mobile-device manufacturers use “advanced multi-technology and multi-channel signaling testing capabilities” [65].  
The implication for signaling testers is that when radar evolves toward communication-integrated sensing, the signaling tester must support multi-technology and multi-channel signaling rather than a single narrow radio link [65].  
The CMX500 knowledge base supports this direction because it is a one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, BLER, throughput, WLAN, and application testing [16][17].  
For non-signaling testers, the raw evidence explicitly identifies “non-signaling” and “with signaling” as separate modes or contexts [66].  
The implication for non-signaling testers is that radar-related measurement needs remain RF-parametric and waveform-centric when no live protocol connection is required [66].  
The CMP200 knowledge base supports this role because it forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution with remote radio heads for RF parametric testing in R&D and manufacturing [43][45].  
The CMP200 also supports mixed radiated mmWave, conducted IF, and conducted mmWave setups for fully assembled devices and mmWave RF integrated circuits, which is relevant when radar or sensing functions move into mmWave hardware [45].  
The CMX500 non-signaling/GPRF material supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF generator instances, and ARB sequencing for standalone waveform generation [55].  
The CMX500 IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save `.wv` files for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling, which supports reuse between signaling and non-signaling workflows [57].  
【推論】As radar shifts from narrow standalone sensing toward high-bandwidth and communications-integrated sensing, signaling testers need broader multi-technology/multi-channel protocol capability, while non-signaling testers need wider-band RF generation/analysis, waveform replay, spectrum analysis, and mmWave/IF measurement paths [60][62][65][45][55].  
【推論】Automotive radar echo testing also requires radar-specific emulation such as artificial range, Doppler, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz bandwidth coverage, which ordinary communication signaling alone does not cover [2][4][11].

- AUX IF input recommended maximum level：[[R&S AREG8-81WS]] `< –18 dBm (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-81WD]] `< –5 dBm (meas.)`。
- AUX IF input frequency range：`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz with 5 GHz`。
- AUX IF input gain：from AUX IF input to TX waveguide output，`17 dB (nom.)`。
- Connectors：RX IF OUT、TX IF IN 與 RX power 為 SMA female；Control 為 26-pin ODU Mini-Snap series L, coding A, push-pull connector。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMP200
[[R&S CMP200]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**；依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，它與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head 組成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，並依 [[CMP200_Features_V8-14-22_en_09]] 透過 options 提供 [[NR FR2]]、[[UWB]]、[[LP-IoT]]、UWB PHY test plans、waveform playback/generation 與 [[R&S VSE]] analysis 相關功能。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Signal types
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，GPRF Generator signal types 包含：

- ARB。
- CW。
- Dual Tone。
- Replay `.wv` files。
- Up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel。
- ARB Sequencer。
- Upload directly in the configuration sidebar。

來源 slide 標示 **No License required**，但該說法需與 technology-specific ARB / WinIQSim2 licensing 分開理解。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Multi-function satellite services（MFSS）
[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 1：同一 satellite 整合多個獨立 hardware / services。
- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

Christoph Pointner, Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz, said: “Integrating our CMX500 OBT with Bluetest’s RTS technology allows mobile device manufacturers to leverage its advanced multi-technology and multi-channel signaling testing capabilities. It unlocks the potential of our tester within Bluetest’s industry-leading reverberation test systems.”
